approve-CoreIdentity.prompt: Run the CoreIdentity approval and renewal script. Execute: python ${LOCAL_SKILLS}/data_tools/coreidentity-approve.py. This handles: (1) approving pending entitlement requests from team members via CoreIdentity/MSApprovals, (2) approving pending UMS requests at ums.microsoft.com, (3) approving pending M365 Pulse CorpIdentity requests at m365pulse.microsoft.com/CorpIdentity/RequestApproval, (4) approving pending IDWeb requests at idweb.microsoft.com (security group membership approvals), (5) retaining pending Trust Portal User Access Review items at trust.microsoft.com/user-access-review/my-reviews, (6) renewing your own expiring memberships, and (7) renewing your own critical CorpIdentity data-access scenario eligibilities that are expired or expiring within 14 days (watchlist in SELF_RENEW_SCENARIOS). Report the results summary printed by the script. If the script reports errors connecting to CDP, note that headless Edge may need to be relaunched. IMPORTANT: If any requests show status 'no_approve_button' or 'Card click did not open detail panel', re-run the script once more -- transient CDP rendering can cause false negatives. If failures persist after retry, report the exact request IDs and error status so they can be manually approved.
approve-CoreIdentity.description: Approve pending entitlement requests and renew own expiring memberships daily

approve-FFv2.prompt: Run the FFv2 approval script with the following extra arguments (may be empty): [{{EXTRA_ARGS}}]. You MUST invoke the script via Bash or powershell script now -- do not skip, do not claim the work was already done, do not assume a prior turn ran it. There is no prior turn. Command to execute: `python ${LOCAL_SKILLS}/data_tools/ffv2-approve.py {{EXTRA_ARGS}}` (when extra args is empty, just run the script with no arguments). The script auto-detects argument type: no args = approve all directs' pending flights, a number = flight ID, a URL containing featureFlight/ = extract ID, anything else = person name. After the script exits, report the results summary it printed.
approve-FFv2.description: Approve all pending FFv2 flights from directs (daily 9:33pm), or targeted by person/ID/URL

approve-PR.prompt: Approve one or more Azure DevOps pull requests. Input (PR IDs and/or a PR URL, often pasted as 'Pull Request <id>: Title' lines) is here -- may be empty: [{{EXTRA_ARGS}}]. Follow the 'approve-PR' job in your agent instructions: (1) parse every unique 6-8 digit PR ID from the input and de-duplicate (the same ID can appear twice under different titles); (2) parse the org from any PR URL (https://<org>.visualstudio.com/...) or default to https://domoreexp.visualstudio.com/; (3) verify the azure-devops CLI extension and confirm auth with `az repos pr show --id <firstId> --org <orgUrl>` -- run `az login` if it fails, and flag any draft PR (do not approve drafts unless explicitly asked); (4) cast the approve vote on each unique ID with `az repos pr set-vote --id <id> --vote approve --org <orgUrl>`; (5) verify a sample registered vote 10 and report a per-PR APPROVED/FAILED table plus an 'Approved: N / Total' summary. You MUST actually run the az commands now via powershell -- do not assume a prior turn did it; there is no prior turn. Only approve the PRs listed; never widen scope; report exact IDs and error text for any failure.
approve-PR.description: Approve one or more Azure DevOps pull requests by ID or URL (on demand)

reapprove-stale-PR.prompt: Re-review and (risk-tiered) re-approve GitHub PRs whose YOUR (qitxu_microsoft) approval was dismissed by a later push. Extra args (may be empty): [{{EXTRA_ARGS}}] -- an optional repo (owner/name; default teams-microsoft/bug-autopilot) and/or --dry-run (review + report only, never approve). Follow the 'reapprove-stale-PR' job in your agent instructions exactly: (0) switch gh to the qitxu_microsoft keyring account (Remove GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN env, then $env:GH_TOKEN=(gh auth token --hostname github.com --user qitxu_microsoft); verify gh api user login == qitxu_microsoft -- the default jqxcode token cannot access teams-microsoft/*); (1) find open PRs you reviewed via `gh pr list --search reviewed-by:qitxu_microsoft`, and for each keep only those where your latest review is APPROVED at commit C, C != headRefOid, reviewDecision != APPROVED, PR open, not draft, not yours; (2) review ONLY the incremental delta with `gh api repos/<repo>/compare/C...head` -- read the actual patch, classify files (safe = docs/tests/config; production = runtime src/), and reason about correctness (bugs, secrets, scope creep); (3) risk-tier: AUTO re-approve only if delta touches ONLY safe files AND <=50 changed lines AND <=3 files AND no issues; CONFIRM first (present review + risk, wait for explicit user go) if it touches production code OR exceeds the size guardrail; STOP + report on any real problem regardless of size; --dry-run forces report-only for all tiers; (4) approve with `gh pr review <N> --repo <repo> --approve --body "Re-reviewed delta C..head: <conclusion>..."`; (5) verify your review now shows APPROVED at the head SHA and report a per-PR table (PR | approved-SHA | head-SHA | delta | tier | action | conclusion) plus a summary. You MUST run the gh commands now via powershell -- there is no prior turn. Never blindly approve; only ever re-approve PRs you had previously approved; never merge; never widen scope beyond the target repo.
reapprove-stale-PR.description: Re-review dismissed-approval GitHub PRs (delta since your approval) and risk-tier re-approve (on demand, GitHub)
